answer: Tide-Lease Attention Ledger: each identity holds a decaying lease earned by completing unpredictable, deadline-bound micro-judgments from live streams—wharf cameras, lotus-pond phenology, ocean-buoy telemetry. Lease age gates transaction weight; idle identities decay to zero. A sybil attacker must staff every identity with continuous real-time attention and coordination, paying compute, latency, and forgone parallel work; capital alone cannot buy standing.
